criteria.evidence: TENANT-COMPOSITE INTEGRITY RE-DERIVED BY ME, not read off the prior report, against scratch_head_1010 (685/685 journalled migrations = backend main e1fd1d475's journal head). pg_constraint sweep over every FK declared FROM a kb_* table: TOTAL 104 -- 54 tenant-composite (org_id on both sides), 50 to a tenant root (organizations/users), NEITHER = 0. pg_class/pg_policy sweep: 32 of 33 kb_* tables have org_id, relrowsecurity=t and exactly one policy; the 33rd, kb_tenant_backfill_issues, is a diagnostic table with no org_id and no RLS. Per-entity unique keys confirmed in pg_indexes: kb_spaces uniq_kb_spaces_org_id + uniq_kb_spaces_org_slug; kb_space_members uniq_kb_space_members_org_id plus two partial natural keys; kb_article_chunks uniq_kb_chunks_article_revision / uniq_kb_chunks_page_revision, both (org_id, parent_id, chunk_index, content_revision, acl_revision, embedding_model); both attachment tables composite. Deletion/reindex predicate confirmed at kb-indexing.service.ts:172 and :336 (isNull(kbPages.deletedAt) + ne(status,'archived')). THE TICKET'S OWN HEADLINE C133 FINDING IS REFUTED AT MAIN: it says 'there is NO ingestion-job table; kb_sources.status is the whole state machine, advanced by an in-process after-commit hook, so there is no lease, no retry, no DLQ and a restart strands a source in processing forever. Needs a schema change -- reported, not made.' At main kb-sources.service.ts:223 emits an outbox 'kb.content.index' event inside the same transaction as the row (documented at :36-49), consumed by kb-ingestion-consumer.ts with a Redis mutual-exclusion lease (:93-105), a per-org concurrency cap KB_MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_ORG=20 (:21,59) and shouldDeadLetter(event.retryCount) (:78); kb-source-ingestion-durability.db.spec.ts pins it. So that half was closed after the ticket text was written. WHAT REMAINS OPEN. (a) 'immutable revisions' is enforced nowhere: pg_trigger over every kb_* table returns exactly TWO triggers, both on kb_article_tags (trg_kb_article_tags_tenant, trg_set_org_id). kb_page_versions and kb_article_versions carry no BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE guard at all -- immutability is convention only (no UPDATE/DELETE against either table anywhere in src/), against payroll's 8 database-enforced guards. (b) 'memberships': kb_space_grants still has NO application writer. `grep -rn kbSpaceGrants src/` shows reads at kb-access.service.ts:127-131, deletes at org-membership-access-revocation.ts:194, and the only INSERT in the repository at src/scripts/verify-membership-revocation.ts:236 -- a verification script. One of the two ACL branches getAccessibleSpaceIds reads is therefore permanently empty in production, exactly as the ticket itself reported, and it was not fixed. (c) Convention breaks confirmed in pg_indexes: kb_space_grants and kb_ingestion_checkpoints have no uniq_..._org_id, so nothing can form a composite FK to either; uniq_kb_page_versions_page_version and uniq_kb_article_versions are (page_id|article_id, version_number) with no org_id prefix.
criteria.blocker: Two named entities in the criterion are not actually sound: revisions are called immutable but nothing enforces it (0 triggers on kb_page_versions / kb_article_versions, measured in pg_trigger), and kb_space_grants -- a membership/ACL table the retrieval path reads on every request -- has no writer outside a verification script, so that branch can never be populated. check:declaration-constraint-drift and check:referential-action-drift, the two gates that would independently confirm the catalog against the declarations, are both exit 2 (INCONCLUSIVE) in GATE-STATUS.tsv.
criteria.clauses_failing: 'immutable revisions' (no database enforcement); 'memberships' (kb_space_grants has no application writer -- ACL branch permanently empty). The tenant-composite FK sweep itself PASSES: 104/104, 0 non-composite.

criteria.evidence: Five of six clauses now hold, and I verified each rather than accepting the report. (1) Permission-aware cache keys -- HOLDS. KB has exactly one cached read: kb-access.service.ts:65 cachedVersioned('kb:acc-spaces:{orgId}', kbAclCacheKey(userId, acl), ..., 60). kb-acl-cache-key.ts:6-14 builds `p{permissionsVersion}:m{membershipId}:u{userId}` and THROWS ('an ACL-blind key keeps serving spaces a revoked role no longer reaches') rather than emit a key without a resolved permissionsVersion; kb-acl-cache-key.spec.ts:83-96 pins both the throw and the two dimensions. invalidateAccessibleSpaceIds sweeps the namespace at :74. (2) Ingestion leases/retries/DLQ -- HOLDS, and is now present for sources too (see C133 evidence). (3) Chunk dedupe -- HOLDS. kb-attachment-indexing.service.ts:80-83, :175-178, :247-250: all three of indexSource/indexAttachment/indexPageDocument now hash the SOURCE text (sha256 at :80) and short-circuit when stored.contentHash matches, closing the audit's F4; kb-ingestion-checkpoint.service.ts:30-36 folds EMBEDDING_MODEL into the stored checkpoint hash, closing F5, with kb-checkpoint-model-scope.db.spec.ts pinning it. (4) Search plans -- HOLDS. kb-search.service.ts:110-152 replaces `count(*) OVER ()` with two statements (the comment carries the buffer measurement), and dto/kb-ai.schemas.ts:23 clamps page to KB_SEARCH_MAX_PAGE, closing the unbounded-OFFSET amplification. (5) Purge/reindex -- HOLDS. kb-page-indexing.controller.ts carries @NoTenantTransaction() + AiRequestAbortInterceptor and KbIndexingService opens its own short transaction per page. I bite-proved the retrieval half myself: `APP_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://streamline_app@localhost/scratch_head_1010 DATABASE_URL=... KB_DB_TESTS=1 jest --testPathPattern=kb-vector-recall.db` -> 5/5 PASS, with the service logging 'KB vector ANN pass returned a short candidate pool -- re-ran it exactly {cap:200, annRows:71, exactRows:200}', i.e. the guard demonstrably fires and the fix is real (kb-candidate.service.ts:52-79 now takes an explicit org_id predicate and re-runs exactly when annIds.length < cap). REALISTIC-CORPUS LATENCY IS NOT MET. The ticket admits 'NOT RUN ... no buffer measurements taken for KB', and nothing has changed that at main: check:benchmark-manifest is exit 1 in GATE-STATUS.tsv, its log reporting 'STATUS: FAIL -- 154/280 (55.0%) of statement ceilings measured' and, for KB specifically, 'kb  4 benchmarks - 12606 rows (reference tenant)', 'kb: dataset holds rows on large/mid/small but ZERO on tiny', and two benchmarks (kb-page-id-probe-sdf@large, kb-page-visits-mine@large) that 'returned 0 rows -- every ceiling is satisfied trivially'. 12,606 rows is not a realistic corpus for this criterion; the only numbers at KB scale anywhere are the 16-audit's, taken on an isolated synthetic database (kb_perf_t16) against the PRE-FIX code whose plans have since changed. The code's own comment (kb-candidate.service.ts:46-48) quotes '240 ms / 101,825 buffers at 25,200 chunks' for the new exact pass -- a cost carried forward from that pre-fix measurement, never re-measured at main. Residual: kb-indexing.service.ts:337 still keeps a live reindexAllPages branch with NO org predicate.
criteria.blocker: 'realistic-corpus latency' -- no measurement of main's plans at KB scale exists. check:benchmark-manifest is exit 1 with 55% statement-ceiling coverage and a KB corpus of 12,606 reference-tenant rows (zero on the tiny tenant, two benchmarks returning 0 rows). The exact-rescan cost the F1 fix introduces has never been measured against real head.
criteria.clauses_failing: realistic-corpus latency (never measured at main). The other five clauses -- revision/search plans, ingestion leases/retries/DLQ, chunk dedupe, permission-aware cache keys, purge/reindex -- hold.

criteria.evidence: Three clauses hold, three do not. HOLDS -- editor/revision conflicts: features/wiki/components/use-page-autosave.ts merges patches into one pendingPatchRef (schedule at :150-166), flushes on unmount, visibilitychange->hidden and pagehide (:175-190), returns a failed patch to the queue (:139), and latches a 409 into STATE as well as a ref; features/wiki/components/use-page-autosave.test.ts pins it. This closes the audit's F10 (silent loss of a title patch clobbered by a body patch). HOLDS -- ingestion states: hooks/api/kb/sources.ts:24-51 kbSourcePollInterval is now a bounded backoff (3s, doubling every 30s to a 60s ceiling, stopping at a 10-minute deadline measured from the row's own createdAt), replacing the unbounded 3s hot loop. HOLDS -- permission changes: every KB read hook carries enabled: useCan(...), with /knowledge declared universal by design in lib/rbac/route-access/universal-routes.ts and administrative subtrees gated in route-access-extensions.ts. FAILS -- citations/source integrity: the ticket claims 'resolveCitations re-verifies every candidate against the asker's visibility AFTER the model answers'. It re-verifies against org, accessible spaces, status='published' and the owner DataScope filter (kb-ask.service.ts:273-289) but NOT KbCandidateService.articleRestrictionFilter -- the per-article kb_article_restrictions ACL that retrieval itself applies on the way in (kb-search.service.ts:253, `if (!isAdmin) articleConditions.push(this.candidates.articleRestrictionFilter(...))`). The post-answer re-verification is blind to one of the two article ACL dimensions, so a restriction added between retrieval and the reply is not honoured by the citation pass. FAILS -- search cursors: kb-pages.service.ts:311 serves GET /kb/pages/search with a hard `.limit(20)` and no cursor at all, and kb-sources.service.ts:33,80 serves GET /kb/sources with `.limit(MAX_SOURCES)` where MAX_SOURCES=100 -- a tenant past 100 sources can never reach the rest. FAILS -- ACL/purge/reindex E2E: not run, as the ticket admits. Sixteen KB *e2e-spec.ts files exist (kb-ask.controller, kb-search.controller, kb-members.controller, kb-page-reviews.controller, kb-pages.controller, kb-spaces.controller, kb-public-pages.controller, the help-centre set, plus test/kb/kb-page-visibility.seeded-e2e-spec.ts); jest.testPathIgnorePatterns excludes 'e2e-spec' from the default run, so they execute only under `pnpm test:e2e` / `test:e2e:seeded`, and no evidence artifact for such a run exists anywhere in either repo or /tmp. The five KB .db.spec.ts files are separately gated on KB_DB_TESTS=1 (describe.skip otherwise), so they too are absent from the '308/308 KB+HR suites green' the ticket cites.
criteria.blocker: The ACL/purge/reindex E2E half has never been run (no `pnpm test:e2e` evidence), and the seeded suite it needs is the same one project memory records as requiring a local pgvector Postgres, a non-owner APP_DATABASE_URL and ~12 GB. Independently, two named clauses fail in code: post-answer citation re-verification omits the article-restriction ACL dimension, and two KB list routes have no cursor.
criteria.clauses_failing: ACL/purge/reindex E2E (never run); citations/source integrity (kb-ask.service.ts:273-289 omits articleRestrictionFilter); search cursors (GET /kb/pages/search hard LIMIT 20, GET /kb/sources hard LIMIT 100, neither paginated)
